title: Long Form Quests Schema for AVIV ScoutRoute

version.description: Version of the long form JSON data. If not present defaults to 1.0.0.

recency_period.description: Number of days after an element was last surveyed (ext:gig_last_updated) before its quests become visible again. If absent, the app defaults to 90 days.

feature-presets.description: Feature presets for the "Add new feature" functionality. If not present, app will not show the "Add new feature" button. If present, the app will show the "Add new feature" button and display the presets.

custom-icons.description: Custom icons for the quest and feature-presets. If we need more icons for the quests or feature-presets, we can add them here. The app will fetch the icons from the given URL and display them in the app.

Element.description: Element type. The base element that describes the type of element and the quests that are associated with it.

element_type.description: Type of element that the quests are associated with.

quest_query.description: Query to get the quests for the element type.

element_type_icon.description: Icon to be displayed for the element type. Must be one of the built-in quest icon names (see QuestIconName), or the name of a custom icon defined in "custom-icons" with type "quest". Built-in icons are fetched from the AVIV ScoutRoute icon set that is locally available.

anyOf.description: Name of a custom icon defined in "custom-icons" with type "quest".

quests.description: List of quests for the element type.

AnswerChoice.description: Answer choice for a single quest. There can be multiple answer choices

choice_text.description: Text to display for the answer choice

image_url.description: URL of the image to display for the answer choice. If the image is not available or if there is an error in loading the image, it will not be displayed.

choice_follow_up.description: Used to define whether the user has to take a picture or not. If not provided, there will be no picture taken. If provided, this text will be shown to the user in the image taking screen.
examples: Is the sidewalk on the left side of the road?
Is the sidewalk on the right side of the road?

dependency.description: Single dependency object to define the dependency of this question on another question. If the required_value of the dependent question is selected, then this question will be visible. Otherwise, it will be hidden.

question_id.description: The Quest ID of the question that this questions visibility is dependent on.

required_value.description: The value of the dependent question that will make this question visible.

Question.description: Question for a single quest. There can be multiple questions for an element.

examples: Is the sidewalk on the left side of the road?
Is the sidewalk on the right side of the road?
Please select the option that best describes the sidewalk on the left side of the road.
Please select the option that best describes the sidewalk on the right side of the road.

quest_image_url.description: URL of the image to display for the question. If the image is not available or if there is an error in loading the image, it will not be displayed.

quest_type.description: Type of the question. ExclusiveChoice for single choice questions, Numeric for numeric input questions, MultipleChoice allows multiple selections entered as a semicolon-delimited string, TextEntry allows free-form text input, and AutoCapture automatically captures one or more tagged values without user interaction.

quest_tag.description: Single tag to be added to the quest. Used by ExclusiveChoice, Numeric, MultipleChoice, and TextEntry quest types. This tag is sent as a payload when the user answers the question. Not used for AutoCapture, which uses auto_capture_attributes instead.

quest_answer_choices.description: Answer choices for the question. Only applicable for ExclusiveChoice and MultipleChoice quest types.

quest_answer_validation.description: Validation for the answer. Only applicable for Numeric type questions.

quest_answer_dependency.description: Defines the dependency of this question on another question. If the required_value of the dependent question is selected, then this question will be visible. Otherwise, it will be hidden. It can be a single object or an array of objects to define multiple dependencies (AND logic).

auto_capture_attributes.description: Attribute-to-tag mapping for AutoCapture quests. Required when quest_type is AutoCapture. Keys are abstract AutoCapture attribute names - all optional, but at least one must be present. Values are the free-form OSW/OSM tag keys to use when submitting the captured data, allowing the app to map attributes to the appropriate tag schema version without requiring schema changes.

ac_width.description: The OSW/OSM tag key to use when submitting the captured width measurement.

ac_incline.description: The OSW/OSM tag key to use when submitting the captured incline measurement.

ac_cross_slope.description: The OSW/OSM tag key to use when submitting the captured cross slope measurement.

ac_surface_integrity.description: The OSW/OSM tag key to use when submitting the captured surface integrity measurement.

ac_surface_disruption.description: The OSW/OSM tag key to use when submitting the captured surface disruption measurement.

ac_height_from_ground.description: The OSW/OSM tag key to use when submitting the captured height from ground measurement.

ac_lidar_depth.description: The OSW/OSM tag key to use when submitting the captured LiDAR depth measurement.

allOf.description: ExclusiveChoice and MultipleChoice quest types require quest_answer_choices.
Numeric and TextEntry quest types require quest_tag.
AutoCapture quest type requires auto_capture_attributes instead of quest_tag.

FeaturePresets.description: Feature preset for the "Add new feature" functionality. The user can upload images for the feature; if added, the image URLs will be appended as a single tag ext:image_url with the URLs separated by semicolons, e.g. ext:image_url=<url1>;<url2>. Custom notes can also be appened via tag ext:notes.

name.description: Name of the feature to be displayed in the "Add new feature" screen. This should be a string that describes the feature type. Must be unique within this file.

icon.description: Icon to be displayed for the feature type. Must be one of the built-in feature-preset icon names (see FeaturePresetIconName), or the name of a custom icon defined in "custom-icons" with type "feature-preset". Built-in icons are fetched from the feature-preset icon set that is locally available.

anyOf.description: Name of a custom icon defined in "custom-icons" with type "feature-preset".

tags.description: Tags for the feature as key/value pairs. These tags will be sent as payload when the user adds a new feature. Keys may themselves contain colons (e.g. "plant:source").

name.description: Name of the custom icon to be displayed in the app. This should be a string that describes the custom icon type. Must be unique within this file.

url.description: URL of the custom icon to be displayed for the custom icon type. The icon will be fetched from the given URL.

type.description: Type of the custom icon. The type can be either "quest" or "feature-preset". If the type is "quest", the custom icon will be used for the quests. If the type is "feature-preset", the custom icon will be used for the feature-presets.

QuestIconName.description: Built-in quest icon names from the AVIV ScoutRoute icon set (creator/src/assets/icons.json).

FeaturePresetIconName.description: Built-in feature-preset icon names from the feature-preset-icons folder.
